decisions.reason: The format plug-ins extend the firm's established integration offer and have their own web page, which signals visible commitment, and they cost little to maintain, so management will persist with them.

The building digital twin service fits the announced direction of integrating geospatial IT with broader enterprise systems, so any weak early results can be put down to a young, still-forming market, which justifies continuing.

The authentication and identity delegation service is close to core security components the firm has already invested in, and slow uptake is easy to attribute to long public-sector procurement cycles, so management keeps it.

The open GIS application framework reflects the firm's strategy of open, extensible components and its standards involvement, which makes it central to the announced direction and unlikely to be abandoned.

The identity service was publicly announced at launch as enabling seamless integration of GIS applications, and that public commitment, together with the R&D already invested, strongly favors persisting with it.
